# vibeoncall_label (Data Source)

Looks up a label by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vibeoncall_label" "sev1" {
  name = "Sev1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Label name. Matched exactly.

### Read-Only

- `color` (String) Hex color code, e.g. `#FF0000`.
- `id` (String) Numeric label ID.
